answer: Because the glacier reference is updated at each opal checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the trellis audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism hence earns nothing extra, so one template cannot pay for 165 aliases however many keys the operator holds. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 5 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
